name: Voice Feedback – let visitors speak their minds in seconds
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Let visitors record and send voice messages right from your site – no login, no forms, no typing – and manage every recording from one dashboard.

Voice Feedback | Pricing | Support

Why Voice Feedback?

Typing feedback takes effort, so most visitors never do it. Voice Feedback makes it easy for visitors to leave audio feedback – and even screen video feedback – on your WordPress site. They simply record their voice; no login or personal details needed.

The plugin adds a voice recording field to your site using a floating drawer, a notification/banner style, a sticky button, a Gutenberg block, or a shortcode. All voice messages are saved in the admin panel, where you can listen to them, mark them as resolved, manage, or delete them as needed.

Perfect for blogs, portfolios, education sites, product pages, or any website where collecting user feedback matters. Built with a lightweight, user-friendly interface for reliable voice feedback collection.

Free Features

  • Voice Recording Field for Users: Visitors record their voice directly from your site without needing an account.
  • Review Before Submit: Users can play back their message before sending and re-record if needed.
  • Admin Voice Library: All submitted voice messages are stored in an organized dashboard.
  • Playback and Management: Listen to each recording, mark it as resolved, or delete it.
  • Full Customization: Customize every Voice Feedback instance to match your site design and workflow.
  • Multiple Display Options: Show a voice feedback drawer site-wide, or add specific instances via block or shortcode.
  • Smooth Animations: Animated feedback forms create a polished, professional user experience.
  • Lightweight and Secure: No personal data is collected; focused only on voice-based interaction.
  • Spam Protection & CAPTCHA: Protect your site from automated spam bots using Cloudflare Turnstile and rate limiting – completely free.

Pro Version

Here is what’s new in Voice Feedback Pro:

  • Admin Email Notifications: Get instant email alerts when a user submits voice feedback. Customize the subject and message body, with the option to attach the recorded audio file.
  • Screen Recording Option: Users can record their screen along with their voice for clear, actionable feedback.
  • Advanced Display Triggers: Control when the global feedback appears – always show, after a scroll limit, when the user reaches the bottom, on scroll down, when a target section enters view, after X seconds, or while a target section is visible.
  • Hide on Scroll Up: Automatically hide the feedback form when users scroll up for a cleaner browsing experience.
  • Position Control: Change where your global feedback appears on the screen.
  • Advanced Customization: Fully customizable color, background color, text typography, and responsiveness.

How to Use

  1. Install and activate the Voice Feedback plugin.
  2. A voice feedback drawer appears automatically on your site.
  3. Visit Voice Library → Settings to customize or disable the drawer.
  4. To place feedback on specific pages, add the Voice Feedback Gutenberg block or generate a shortcode from the Voice Library menu.
  5. Listen to and manage submissions from the Voice Library dashboard.

Use Cases

  • Collect user voice feedback and suggestions.
  • Add audio comments or voice comments to blog posts.
  • Enable clients to send quick voice updates.
  • Get spoken UX feedback or testimonials.
  • Receive spoken suggestions or bug reports.

Upcoming Features

  • Contact form integration with voice field
  • Integration with project/task management tools

Check out our other WordPress Plugins

  • HTML5 Audio Player – Best audio player plugin for WordPress.

  • PDF Poster – A fully-featured PDF Viewer Plugin for WordPress.

  • StreamCast – A fully-featured Radio Player Plugin for WordPress.

  • 3D Viewer – Display interactive 3D models on the webs.

Source Code

You can find the source code, report bugs, and contribute to the development of this plugin on our GitHub repository:
Voice Feedback on GitHub

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services. Connections are made only from the plugin’s admin dashboard pages and are not triggered for your site’s visitors on the front end.

bPlugins API

  • Service: bPlugins product API – https://api.bplugins.com
  • What it does: When you open the plugin’s dashboard, the plugin requests product information (such as the plugin’s own details and other plugins by bPlugins) so it can display product cards, version information, and upgrade options.
  • What data is sent: A request is made to the bPlugins API endpoint with the product identifier (e.g. https://api.bplugins.com/wp-json/bpl/v1/products/{id}). No personal data or site content is sent as part of this request.
  • When: Only while an administrator is viewing the plugin’s dashboard in wp-admin.
  • Terms of Service: https://bplugins.com/terms-of-service/
  • Privacy Policy: https://bplugins.com/privacy-policy/

WordPress.org Plugins API

  • Service: WordPress.org Plugins Info API – https://api.wordpress.org
  • What it does: The dashboard queries the public WordPress.org Plugins API to list other plugins published by the author (titles, icons, ratings, active installs, etc.).
  • What data is sent: A public, read-only query request (e.g. https://api.wordpress.org/plugins/info/1.2/?action=query_plugins&request[author]=bplugins). No personal data is sent.
  • When: Only while an administrator is viewing the plugin’s dashboard in wp-admin.
  • Terms of Service: https://wordpress.org/about/privacy/
  • Privacy Policy: https://wordpress.org/about/privacy/

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin bundles the following third-party JavaScript/PHP libraries.

Freemius SDK

  • Source: https://freemius.com/
  • GitHub: https://github.com/Freemius/wordpress-sdk
  • License: GPLv3 – https://github.com/Freemius/wordpress-sdk/blob/master/LICENSE.txt
  • Purpose: Provides opt-in usage tracking and analytics to help improve the plugin.

bpl-tools

  • Source / GitHub: https://github.com/bPlugins/bpl-tools
  • License: GPL-2.0-or-later – https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
  • Purpose: Shared utility library providing admin dashboard components and common Gutenberg editor controls.
  • External Services: The library may connect to bPlugins, WordPress.org, and Freemius services for product data and checkout functionality. See full details: https://github.com/bPlugins/bpl-tools#external-requests–why-they-are-made
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Voice Feedback”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. A voice feedback drawer will appear automatically on your site.
  5. Visit Voice Library → Settings to customize or disable the drawer.

Manual installation:

  1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the Gutenberg block or generate a shortcode from the admin to place the recorder on specific pages.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin collect personal data?

No. It only records the voice message. No name, email, or contact information is collected.

Do visitors need an account to leave feedback?

No. Visitors can record and send their voice message without logging in or providing personal details.

Where can I access submitted recordings?

All voice recordings are stored in the Voice Library admin menu, where you can play, mark as resolved, or delete them.

Can visitors listen to their recording before sending it?

Yes. Users can play back their message before submitting and re-record it if needed.

Does it protect against spam submissions?

Yes. The free version includes spam protection and CAPTCHA using Cloudflare Turnstile, plus rate limiting to stop automated bots.

Can I get an email when someone leaves feedback?

Yes, admin email notifications are available in the Pro version – including a customizable subject and body, with the option to attach the audio file.

Can I turn off the floating voice drawer?

Yes. Go to Voice Library → Settings and disable the drawer with a single toggle.

How do I add voice feedback to a specific post or page?

Use the Voice Feedback block in Gutenberg or copy the shortcode from Voice Library → Voice Feedbacks.

Is it compatible with all WordPress themes?

Yes. It works with all modern, well-coded themes.

Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the Voice Feedback plugin through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment, and notify the developers of this plugin.

2.2.4 – 25 June 2026

  • New: Added completely free Rate Limit and Spam Protection CAPTCHA feature using Cloudflare Turnstile to prevent spam submissions.

2.2.3 – 10 June 2026

  • Update: Removed restricted “Locked Fields” to improve user flexibility
  • New: Added Email Gate option to require users to enter their name and email before submitting voice feedback.
  • Fix: Corrected translation string extractor parser crashes in npm run i18n.
  • Fix: Standardized vertical layout of titles and subtitles in settings cards.

2.2.2 – 5 March 2026

  • Update: Redesigned the dashboard with a modern and improved user interface, replacing the previous outdated layout.

2.2.1 – 4 Feb 2026

  • update: Improved user admin experience and settings layout for better usability.

2.2.0 – 28 January 2026

  • Added admin email notifications — when a user submits voice feedback, the admin now receives an email with a custom subject and body, with the option to attach the audio file.
  • Replaced AJAX with the REST API to deliver a faster and smoother admin experience.
  • Optimized plugin files and improved performance and overall code readability.

2.1.0

  • Added new templates and improvement.

2.0.0

  • Added new features and improvements

1.0.3

  • Fixed Vulnerability Issues

1.0.2

  • Fixed Issue

1.0.1

  • Updated with new features

1.0.0

  • Initial release with core features: drawer, block, shortcode, admin library, and basic customization.
